title: LessonModel
$comment: DRAFT — NEEDS_REVIEW. Field set is a hypothesis; no code reads it yet. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-0007 and specs/lesson-model.md (not authored yet).
description: Layer B artifact. Models what the current lesson contains before the existing knowledge network is consulted heavily, so incoming material is not distorted by prior beliefs.

version.description: Schema version this instance conforms to.

sourceMapRef.description: Reference to the SourceMap that grounds this model.
sourceMapRef.$comment: TODO: whether this is an id, a path or an embedded object is undecided.

segments.description: Ordered content units of the lesson.

kind.description: What kind of content this segment is. Teacher analogies, opinions and problem-solving tips MUST be distinguishable from taught content (see docs/ERROR_TAXONOMY.md LSN-*).

summary.description: Compact description of the segment, not a full transcription.

claims.description: Statements the segment makes, each traceable to evidence.

provenance.description: Evidence locators supporting this claim. Required in spirit: a claim without provenance is unverified.

epistemicStatus.description: Epistemic state of the claim. Machine inference must never silently become verified.

formulaLike.description: True when the claim is formula-heavy; such content needs separate handling.

uncertainties.description: Explicit open questions raised by this lesson, so they are not silently resolved.
